title: a throwing test fails only itself
purpose: Run embedded tests and observe the exit status.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 14: an uncaught throw fails only the current test; the run exits 1 because a test failed.
